title: Chapter 265: I Give Up!
html:
The three students pressed tightly together. Their attention remained fixed on the mannequin in the corridor, and none heard the strange sound behind them.

“Should we retreat into the bedroom?” Yang Chen offered the safest option, unable to understand why a mannequin frightened him so deeply.

“Since we’ve abandoned the challenge, there’s no reason to keep going,” Wang Dan said. “Find a security camera and ask an employee to lead us out.”

Li Xue stared at the mannequin blocking the corridor. “When we entered, I noticed that this area has no security cameras.”

“Xiao Xue, why didn’t you mention something that important?” Wang Dan had remained composed only because he believed an employee would respond the moment visitors requested help through a camera. The certainty of escape had kept his fear in check.

“Because you didn’t ask.” Li Xue rolled her eyes. “Don’t worry. A professional like Boss Chen must have installed enough cameras. They’re probably concealed here to preserve the atmosphere.”

“Atmosphere is no longer the issue!” Wang Dan squeezed behind Yang Chen. “That mannequin appeared in the corridor. It followed us out!”

“Something is wrong.” Yang Chen frowned as the intensifying stench made his heart tremble. “According to the diary, the abused boy was severely overweight. The hanging figure in the first room is thin.”

“Must you analyze this now?” Wang Dan urged them forward. “What if all three of us charge together? It has only two hands—it cannot stop everyone.”

“Be quiet.” Yang Chen pushed his arm away. “The overweight boy cannot be the hanging man. That means this hidden scenario contains another theme—two separate stories!”

“Two stories? You mean another monster hasn’t appeared yet?” Li Xue understood immediately. She looked past Yang Chen toward the bedroom they had just left. Her eyes widened, and all color drained from her face.

“Xiao Xue? What’s wrong with you?”

Li Xue seemed to lose her voice. Two seconds passed before she forced out the words. “Behind you!”

Yang Chen and Wang Dan turned together. The plastic-wrapped corpse stood in the bedroom doorway, its body contorted as though struggling to break free. Worse, a cloud of stinking vapor gathered behind it, slowly condensing into a rounded shadow.

“Is that a special eff—what is that?” Standing at the rear, Wang Dan was closest to the plastic-wrapped body. When he turned, only inches separated their faces. His body fled before his mind caught up. A meter away, he finally screamed, “Run!”

The shout jolted Yang Chen and Li Xue from their stupor, and they raced after him. But the hanging mannequin blocked the corridor. It raised its head, revealing a swollen face mottled purple, then bounded toward them faster than any of the students could run.

“F*ck me!” Having sprinted from the rear to the front, Wang Dan now faced the charging mannequin. His face turned green.

Trapped between two horrors, he was terrified but dared not stop. Summoning all the courage he possessed, Wang Dan closed his eyes, clenched his teeth, and rammed the mannequin.

BANG!

The impact hurled the mannequin into the wall. Wang Dan charged onward blindly, hands shielding his face. With the path clear, Yang Chen and Li Xue rushed past as well. Neither noticed one small detail.

After falling, the mannequin’s lips creaked into a ghastly smile. The rope around its neck slithered toward Li Xue’s ankle. Just before it coiled around her, the mannequin seemed to recall something terrifying and hastily withdrew it.

“They’re still chasing after us!”

Their screams echoed loudly enough for every visitor underground to hear. At last they escaped Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy. Fear, shock, and desperate exertion left the three medical students feeling as though they had returned from a tour of hell.

“I can’t run any farther.” The least athletic of the three, Li Xue gasped for breath, her face white and cold sweat streaming down it.

“Rest. We… we can afford a moment.” Yang Chen was also breathless. Leaning against the scenario entrance, he turned to check on Wang Dan. During their escape, he had clearly seen Wang Dan collide with the mannequin.

“Wang Dan, are you okay?”

Wang Dan, who refused to admit fear even when trembling, now crouched on the floor with both hands over his head, clenching his jaw to hold back tears.

“Wang Dan! Don’t scare me!”

“Yang Chen, I can’t do this anymore.” Tears entered the defiant young man’s voice. “That mannequin wasn’t hollow. This place is f*cking terrifying. I surrender. Let’s call the police.”

“All right. We’re done. Let’s find the exit.” Yang Chen had suffered his own severe fright. He tried to lift Wang Dan, but the young man’s strength had vanished and his legs were useless.

“Find a camera and call an employee. I understand this Haunted House’s strategy now. It begins gently so we lower our guard, then saves the true horrors for later.” Li Xue had also surrendered. Unwilling to remain alone near the scenario, she staggered toward the others. “In our condition, we’ll never reach the exit unaided.”

“I remember a camera at every junction. Wait here while I get help.”

Yang Chen was about to leave when Wei Wu and Kong Xiangming appeared. They seemed to sense something; rather than acknowledge the students, both stared at the entrance to Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.
